text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is injured during training,
so I
escort her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest apologies. My negligence
has
caused you concern.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that my treatment is finished, let's
get back
to training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Of course. It doesn't hurt, so there
should be no
issue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this kind of injury is
commonplace in the
martial arts world.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect, I don't believe that
an injury
of this nature warrants rest.
choice_data_list: 無理のない範囲で再開しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's play it safe and take a break.
Let's ease back into it without overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to fall behind. Please allow
me to
continue training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haste does make waste. In the martial
arts world,
it's commonplace to hear of
injuries caused by
overexertion.
choice_data_list: 油断大敵、遅れた分はあとで追いつこう
choice_data_list_en: Stay on your toes—we'll make up for the lost time later.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I understand. If you insist, I'll rest up and
focus my
energy on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki sounds slightly
disappointed as she
sets off back to her
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for understanding. Shall we
head to
the track?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I test the waters by assigning her a light
run, but
Yaeno Muteki soon looks
pained.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I'll focus on recovering for
now.
choice_data_list: やっぱりこれ以上はやらせられない
choice_data_list_en: I really can't let you do any more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I deeply apologize for dragging you out
to the
track...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki sounds remorseful as she
heads
back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whew... A lighter training session should
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You needn't be concerned. I'll limit my
efforts as
a matter of course.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in having the resolve to
weather
injuries of this caliber.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki completes a light training
session
while taking care not to
aggravate her injury.
